visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing a white short-sleeved t-shirt and tan shorts, stands on a small black cushioned piano stool in a compact, modern studio apartment with high ceilings. A woman with long dark hair in a pink polo shirt and white trousers stands beside him, pointing toward the tall, dark gray built-in wardrobes that reach the ceiling. The room features a bed with gray linens and a large black-framed glass partition. (2) The man steps from the piano stool onto the top of a black upright piano to reach the uppermost storage cabinet of the wardrobe. The woman looks up with a surprised facial expression, covering her mouth with her hands. Bright, natural daylight streams in from a window behind them, illuminating the sleek furniture and minimal decor. (3) The scene cuts to a narrow kitchen area where the man stands on a green upholstered chair and then steps onto the white kitchen counter to open a high-placed overhead cabinet. The woman watches from the floor, laughing and gesturing toward the storage space. The kitchen has a minimalist design with white cabinets and a dark countertop with a stove.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to humorously showcase the extreme high-ceiling storage of a expensive compact studio apartment in Taipei, highlighting the 'athletic' effort required to utilize all available space.
